recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: Which animal scares them the most?
Spiders or heights: which is worse?
What movie scared them the most?
What are they afraid to lose?
Do they get scared in the dark?
What makes them nervous in public?
What is the one thing they never try?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Fears edition: 8 questions about what scares your partner. Do you know their biggest fear?

Comment your score!
